title: Nying` Mamit Nayudie Dala
author: Traditional
content:
{title: Nying` Mamit Nayudie Dala}

{comment: Verse 1}
Nying mamit  nayudie dala kasechier
Nying mamit  nayudie dala kasechier
Kaloyo  lwenja nayudi ngima,
Kaloyo lwenja to nayudi ngima
Kaloyo lwenja to nayudi ngima.
Nying mamit nayudie edala kasechie!

{comment: Verse 2}
Osimbo loch narwaki edala kachopo
Osimbo loch narwaki edala kachopo
Kaloyo lwenja norwaka malo,
Kaloyo lwenja to norwaka malo
Kaloyo lwenja to norwaka malo
Osimbo loch narwaki e dala kachopo!

{comment: Verse 3}
Ruoth to jagedo mogeronwa udi,
Ruoth to jagedo mogeronwa udi
Ruoth to jagedo mogeronwa udi
Wabiro dakie kwadonjo epolo,
Wabiro dakie ka wadonje edala mor
Wabiro dakie ka wadonje edala mor
Ruoth to jagedo mogeronwa udi !

{comment: Verse 4}
Chunya emaringo kochiko ei polo,
Chunya ema ringo kochiko  dala Ruodha
Chunya ema ringo kochiko  dala Ruodha
Chunya  nomorie dala gi yesu ,
Chunya nomorie dala gi jawar
Chunya nomorie dala gi jawar
Chunya emaringo kochiko ei polo!

{comment: Verse 5}
Los yor chunyi ma iniluw kidhiyo,
Los yor chunyi mibiro luwo c hieng` tho
Los yor chunyi mibiro luwo c hieng` tho
Ogandani duto magi niwete,
Anyuoani duto jogi niwegi chieng` tho
Anyuoani duto jogi niwegi chieng` tho
Los yor chunyi ma iniluw kidhiyo!
